visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a young girl lie on a tan pillow in a dimly lit room, facing the camera; the girl smiles and talks while the man listens with his eyes mostly closed. Background shelves hold a white plush toy with a yellow beak and a dark beverage cup. (2) The girl sits up on the bed, wearing a pink long-sleeved shirt and a grey puffer vest, looking excited and gesturing with her hands. (3) The scene shifts to the girl standing in front of light-colored wooden shelves filled with children's artwork and toys, then she moves to a large wooden wardrobe and opens its doors. (4) The girl is shown outdoors at night near a white car, putting on her vest while smiling brightly. (5) Inside the car, the camera captures the girl in the back seat and views of street lights passing by outside the window. (6) The man and girl walk through a bustling outdoor night market; the man holds the girl's hand as they pass various food stalls and neon signs. (7) They sit at a stainless steel table in a brightly lit eatery; the girl points at a menu sheet while the man uses a red pen to mark it. (8) Both characters eat from white bowls filled with douhua, smiling and laughing at each other while using metal spoons. (9) The girl is shown walking home at night, playing and skipping along the pavement. (10) In a white-tiled bathroom, the man and girl stand before a mirror; the girl brushes her teeth while the man films with his phone. (11) Finally, the girl is tucked into a bed with green sheets, closing her eyes as the lights dim.
